ourRead: 1 tier: 9 of 10 listings are Finch Plus, from $5.99 to $69.99. The 10th, Guardian Program at $7.99, is the only other name.
Prices lean high: 7 of 9 Finch Plus listings run $34.99 to $69.99. The top is 11.7x the lowest, $5.99, and all 10 end in .99.
Value comes first: a pet bird on all 8 screenshots, 6 of 8 headlines about doing it together, and Plus only in the In-App Purchases list.

improvements.title: Put the term in every listing name
improvements.detail: 9 listings read “Finch Plus” at 8 prices, $5.99 to $69.99, with $39.99 twice. Add the term to each, like “Finch Plus, 1 year”, and name what Guardian Program, $7.99, buys.
improvements.rule: Fix 3 things to stop a design from looking cheap: low contrast, a broken layout, and copy that does not convert.

improvements.title: Take the grass labels to 4.5:1
improvements.detail: White “Goal Buddies”, “3 goals left today!” and “START THE DAY” sit on #7BB65C grass at 2.4:1. Set them in #101820, the icon’s eye color, for 7.4:1.
improvements.rule: Text contrast: at least 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for text 24 px and larger.

improvements.title: Swap “millions” for 776,001 ratings
improvements.detail: Screenshot 8 says “join millions growing with you”. Apple’s data showed 4.9 stars from 776,001 ratings on 15 Nov 2026. Write that number: “Rated 4.9 from 776,001 ratings”.
improvements.rule: Make headlines specific. "Track 3 habits in 10 seconds a day" beats "Transform your life".

stylePrompt: Build a paywall in Finch’s style. Top to bottom: your mascot in a sky scene with a white speech bubble, a 3-line headline, white plan cards, one full-width button. Type: Rubik, bold headline in dark blue #1F4F9A, medium labels. Colors: sky blue #9DDDFF (60) for the screen, white #FFFFFF (30) for cards and the bubble, bright blue #0E9BE2 (10) for the button and the selected card’s outline. Button text #101820. Corners about 24 px. Plans: one tier in rows with length and price; preselect the longest and show its per-month price. Show a trial only if you offer one. Use my brand colors in the same 60/30/10 roles.
